name: Ramallo
text:
[When Played:] Heal 2 damage from a unit or base. You may defeat a friendly Spice token. If you do, heal 3 damage from it.
[When Defeated:] Attach this card as an upgrade to a friendly non-[{Vehicle}] [{Fremen}] or [{Bene Gesserit}] unit.
subtitle: Reverend Mother of Sietch Tabr
